location: POWER PLANT - CLOSE ON MAN'S BODY
summary: A man's body spasms inside a magenta amnion, fighting the gelatin until he ruptures the shroud and tears himself free. He is revealed to be Neo, bald and naked, standing in an oval capsule of clear alloy whose surface has solidified. He discovers IVs grafted to his flesh, an enormous coaxial cable locked into the base of his skull that he cannot remove, and rows of other pods containing motionless human beings. Looking out, he sees towers of glowing capsules spiraling up and down into an abyss. A machine drops before him, unlocks the cable at his skull, slides a needle and cerebrum-chip out of his skull, snaps free the other hoses, and then opens a vacuum that sucks the gelatin and Neo into a black hole.

what_changes.before: Trapped and struggling inside the magenta amnion, unable to breathe as "Air bubbles into the Jell-O but does not break the surface."
what_changes.after: Emerged from the cell, standing free but "Dizzy, nauseous," bald and naked, waiting for his vision to focus.
what_changes.evidence: Unable to breathe, he fights wildly to stand, clawing at the thinning elastic shroud, until it ruptures

what_changes.before: An anonymous struggling body whose identity is unknown.
what_changes.after: Recognized as Neo, who then comprehends the scale of the horror around him as he surveys the endless towers of human-filled pods.
what_changes.evidence: It is Neo. He is bald and naked, his body slick with gelatin.

what_changes.before: Awake and exploring, trying to free himself from the cable at his skull, which "would be easier to pull off a finger."
what_changes.after: Seized and paralyzed by a machine that detaches all his connections and sucks him into a black hole, helpless.
what_changes.evidence: The machine seizes hold of Neo, paralyzing him as the cable lock at the back of his neck spins and opens.

event_hint.one_line: Neo ruptures free from his amnion pod, beholds the vast human-farm, and is then detached and vacuumed out by a machine.

objects_that_matter: metal tubes / IVs grafted to his flesh
enormous coaxial cable locked into the base of his skull
other pods filled with human beings
towers of glowing petals / center core / black metal stem
uncertain: Whether the machine's removal of Neo is intended to rescue him or to harm him.
What lies beyond the black hole that Neo is sucked into.

minds.wants: To breathe, to stand, and to understand what he is seeing — to find purchase in a reality that denies him all three.
minds.feels: Raw physiological panic (dizzy, nauseous, air-starved) colliding with a dawning, wordless horror. The 'splinter in the mind' Morpheus named in sc-029 has become an entire landscape; the abstract wrongness he felt his whole life is now literal and vast. His instinct is to pull the cable free — to reverse the intrusion — but he cannot, which converts agency into helplessness.
minds.shows: Only a struggling, silent animal: clawing at the shroud, swallowing his scream, waiting for vision to focus. There is no one to perform for; everything he lets be seen is involuntary.
minds.basis: The struggle to rupture the amnion and 'suck for air'; 'waits for his vision to focus'; the attempt to pull out the skull cable that 'would be easier to pull off a finger'; 'The image assaults his mind'; 'He swallows his scream.'

believes_about.other: Morpheus / the promise behind the red pill
believes_about.belief: That waking from the Matrix would mean standing up as a free man in a real world he could comprehend.
believes_about.wrong_because: The truth is not liberation-as-standing but liberation-as-fetus: he is hairless, naked, grafted, and one unit among towers of human batteries. Freedom here looks exactly like being harvested.

believes_about.belief: That it is an enemy seizing and paralyzing him — a threat to be feared.
believes_about.wrong_because: It is also performing the unplugging that frees him; the same hands that violate him are removing the very cable he could not remove himself. Rescue and violation are the same act, which he cannot yet hold together.

minds.wants: To service the pod: detach the connections and clear the unit of its occupant and its gelatin.
minds.feels: Nothing legible — it acts with precise, insectile efficiency, 'stares' only in the sense Neo projects onto it.
minds.shows: A drop, a seize, a paralyze, a spin-and-open of the lock, withdrawal of needle and cerebrum-chip, snapping of hoses, then the vacuum. No negotiation, no pause, no regard.
minds.basis: The ordered sequence of mechanical actions ending in the 'tremendous vacuum' that 'sucks the gelatin and then Neo into a black hole.'

connects_back: Morpheus's naming of the 'splinter in your mind' and 'something wrong with the world' (sc-029) — this scene is the literal answer to that feeling.
The 'look of a man who accepts what he sees because he is expecting to wake up' (sc-029) — Neo's expectation of waking is now being brutally refuted by a reality that will not let him pull free.
The dissolving mirror-liquid body in sc-030 — the digital self unspooling is the same event as the physical body rupturing its amnion here.
The red pill as a trace program that makes 'Kansas go bye-bye' (sc-030) — the mechanism that locates and unplugs him is what lands him in this pod.
sets_up: ev-007: Neo's helpless transport through the waste-disposal vacuum into the hovercraft's recovery.
ev-008: The discovery of his grafted ports and atrophied body on the Nebuchadnezzar — the physical modifications first seen here.
ev-009: The explanation of the fetus-fields and human-as-battery that this vista of towers demands and that his mind will reject.
ev-010: The confirmation that he cannot return — the irreversible severing begun by the machine here.
dramatic_function: It converts the film's philosophical premise into visceral, bodily fact — the 'truth' Morpheus promised becomes an abyss of human batteries — and completes Neo's unplugging by handing the act of liberation to the very system that enslaves him, so that freedom and violation arrive as one inseparable shock.
